definition: to shout to show you dislike a show
description: In a small comedy club lit by a spotlight, a comedian bends forward on the stage near a microphone stand. In the audience a young man in a rust shirt over a white T-shirt stands up from his table, cups one hand at his mouth to shout and raises his other hand with the thumb pointing down, while a man behind him holds up two thumbs down. A paper plane flies through the beam of light and falls to the floor. A waitress walks between small wooden tables with beers on them.
